name: studio_list
description: Read saved carousels, thumbnails, channel art, generation progress, the shared AI credit balance and, for a key or app, today's AI-credit ceiling.

name: studio_job
description: Read a saved generation.

arguments.name: jobId
arguments.desc: The id of the generation to read.

name: studio_project
description: Read a carousel, thumbnail or channel art document and revision.

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: The Studio project to read.

name: studio_save
description: Save an edited Studio document at its current revision.

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: The Studio project to save.

arguments.name: revision
arguments.desc: The project's current revision; a stale revision is refused.

arguments.name: document
arguments.desc: The edited Studio document.

name: studio_export
description: Render the saved revision to ordered JPEG slides (free).

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: The Studio project to export.

arguments.name: revision
arguments.desc: The saved revision to render.

name: trends_search
description: Use this when the person wants ideas for their next video, asks what is trending or taking off in a topic, or wants to see what worked for other creators.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: The topic or niche, in any language.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: A feed instead of a query.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Keep only the videos tagged with this format.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: youtube (default), tiktok or instagram.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: The language the videos should be in.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: How far back it looks.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Where the page starts: 0 (default) for the first, then the number of items received so far, while the answer says more: true.

arguments.name: pay
arguments.desc: true reads further on TikTok or Instagram when the answer's more_cost is above 0: 1 AI credit, given back when nothing new is found.

name: trends_radar
description: Use this when the person wants to keep an eye on a topic: Trends' Radar checks a standing search once a day and keeps the videos that took off since (by default ×2+ their creator's usual views and 5,000 views; on YouTube without ×N, 10,000 views), and Hub e-mails the person once a day at most when there are new ones.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: list (default), add or found.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: add: the topic, as the person would search for it.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: add: youtube (default), tiktok or instagram.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: add: the language the videos should be in.

arguments.name: min_views
arguments.desc: add: the views a video needs.

arguments.name: min_multiplier
arguments.desc: add: how far above its creator's usual a video has to go.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: found: the radar's id from list.

name: list_library_folders
description: Use this when the person asks you to use their own photos or videos ("use my favourites", "a picture from my trip"), before you look for stock media.

name: list_library_assets
description: Use this to browse one shared folder from list_library_folders, newest first.

arguments.name: folder
arguments.desc: A folder id from list_library_folders.

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.desc: nextCursor from the previous page; leave out for the first.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many to return, at most 40 (default 40).

name: get_library_asset
description: Use this to see one picture before choosing it: returns its facts and a small copy (480 px) as an image you can look at.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: A picture id from list_library_assets.

name: whoami
description: The current profile's ID and name, and what this credential is allowed to do: its mode (autopilot publishes; review only prepares), its scopes, the channels it can reach, how many posts it has left today, and whether the account's subscription allows publishing at all.

name: list_platforms
description: Every network Mellow publishes to and the rules it enforces: caption limits, media counts and kinds, required fields, available placements.

name: list_channels
description: The owner's connected accounts, with the channel IDs you name in a post.

arguments.name: refresh
arguments.desc: Re-read from the provider before answering.

name: connect_channel
description: Use this when the person wants to connect a social media account to Mellow Hub.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: One of: instagram, tiktok, tiktok_business, youtube, x, linkedin, threads, bluesky, pinterest, facebook, telegram.

arguments.name: connectionType
arguments.desc: Instagram: instagram or facebook.

name: register_media
description: Checks that a public https URL can be fetched and reports what it is.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: A public https URL to an image or video.

name: request_upload_url
description: A signed URL to PUT file bytes to, plus the media URL to use in a post afterwards.

name: validate_post
description: Use this before create_post, and when the person asks whether a caption, video or image fits a network's limits.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.desc: The text of the post.

arguments.name: media
arguments.desc: Ordered media.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.desc: Channel IDs from list_channels: spc_… for most networks, tgc_… for a Telegram channel.

arguments.name: scheduledAt
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 time to publish at.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Per-network settings, keyed by platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, tiktok_business, youtube, x, linkedin, pinterest, bluesky, telegram.

arguments.name: perChannel
arguments.desc: Overrides for one channel, keyed by channel ID.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.desc: Keep it in Mellow as a draft.

name: preview_post
description: Renders what the post will look like on each network, without publishing.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.desc: The text of the post.

arguments.name: media
arguments.desc: Ordered media.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.desc: Channel IDs from list_channels: spc_… for most networks, tgc_… for a Telegram channel.

arguments.name: scheduledAt
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 time to publish at.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Per-network settings, keyed by platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, tiktok_business, youtube, x, linkedin, pinterest, bluesky, telegram.

arguments.name: perChannel
arguments.desc: Overrides for one channel, keyed by channel ID.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.desc: Keep it in Mellow as a draft.

name: create_post
description: Use this when the person wants a post published now or scheduled on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Facebook or Telegram.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.desc: The text of the post.

arguments.name: media
arguments.desc: Ordered media.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.desc: Channel IDs from list_channels: spc_… for most networks, tgc_… for a Telegram channel.

arguments.name: scheduledAt
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 time to publish at.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Per-network settings, keyed by platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, tiktok_business, youtube, x, linkedin, pinterest, bluesky, telegram.

arguments.name: perChannel
arguments.desc: Overrides for one channel, keyed by channel ID.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.desc: Keep it in Mellow as a draft.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: 8–120 characters, stable for this post.

name: get_post
description: The post and its per-channel outcome, with the public link where a network published.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The post's id.

name: list_posts
description: Recent posts, newest first, optionally filtered by status.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: One of: draft, pending_review, scheduled, publishing, published, partial, failed, cancelled.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: 1 to 100; 20 by default.

name: reschedule_post
description: Moves an existing scheduled post to a future ISO 8601 time.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The scheduled post to move.

arguments.name: scheduledAt
arguments.desc: Future ISO 8601 time including a timezone.

name: update_post
description: Changes a saved post in place, keeping its id: caption, media, channels, per-network settings and time.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The post to change, from create_post or list_posts.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.desc: The text of the post.

arguments.name: media
arguments.desc: Ordered media.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.desc: Channel IDs from list_channels: spc_… for most networks, tgc_… for a Telegram channel.

arguments.name: scheduledAt
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 time to publish at.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Per-network settings, keyed by platform: instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, tiktok_business, youtube, x, linkedin, pinterest, bluesky, telegram.

arguments.name: perChannel
arguments.desc: Overrides for one channel, keyed by channel ID.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.desc: Keep it in Mellow as a draft.

name: retry_post
description: Sends a post again to the networks that did not take it; where it is already out, nothing changes.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The post to send again.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.desc: With postId: only these of its failed channels.

name: post_results
description: Use this when the person asks how one post performed: views, likes and links per network.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: Omit for the most recent published post.

name: account_overview
description: Use this when the person asks how their social media accounts are doing overall.

name: get_metrics
description: Reads recent published posts and network-reported metrics for the channels this credential can reach.

arguments.name: channelId
arguments.desc: Narrows the result to one channel.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Recent posts per channel; defaults to 25.

name: cancel_post
description: Withdraws a post that has not gone out yet.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The post to withdraw.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: Must be true.

name: list_autoreplies
description: Reads the Instagram accounts connected for auto-replies, the rules that answer their comments and direct messages, and what the rules answered recently.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id of one account; needed with posts when several are connected.

arguments.name: posts
arguments.desc: Also return that account's recent posts.

name: create_autoreply
description: Use this when the person wants comment-to-DM on Instagram: a keyword in a comment (for example GUIDE) gets a public reply and a direct message with a link.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies.

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: What the rule answers.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The Instagram post a comment rule listens on, from list_autoreplies with posts: true.

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Words to listen for, up to 40 characters each.

arguments.name: replies
arguments.desc: Reply variants; one is picked per answer.

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Comment rules only: the private message sent to the commenter, up to 1000 bytes of UTF-8 as Instagram counts it (about 500 Cyrillic characters).

name: update_autoreply
description: Changes a rule's keywords, replies, private message or post, or turns it on or off with enabled.

arguments.name: ruleId
arguments.desc: The rule's id, from list_autoreplies.

arguments.name: keywords
arguments.desc: Words to listen for (1 to 10).

arguments.name: replies
arguments.desc: Public reply variants (up to 5).

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Comment rules only.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: Comment rules only.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: Turns the rule on or off.

name: delete_autoreply
description: Deletes a rule.

arguments.name: ruleId
arguments.desc: The rule to delete.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: Must be true.

name: list_comments
description: Use this when the person asks what people commented on their Instagram posts.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: Only this Instagram post's comments, an id from list_autoreplies with posts: true.

arguments.name: unansweredOnly
arguments.desc: Only the comments that still wait for an answer.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Default 7.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Default 25.

name: reply_to_comment
description: Use this when the person wants to answer an Instagram comment, publicly or in a private message.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies. May be left out when one account is connected.

arguments.name: commentId
arguments.desc: From list_comments.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The public reply, up to 1,000 characters.

arguments.name: privateMessage
arguments.desc: The private message, up to 1,000 bytes of UTF-8 as Instagram counts it (about 500 Cyrillic characters).

name: list_messages
description: Use this when the person asks about their Instagram direct messages (DMs).

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies. May be left out when one account is connected.

arguments.name: waitingOnly
arguments.desc: Only the conversations that wait for an answer.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Default 15.

name: reply_to_message
description: Use this when the person wants to answer an Instagram direct message.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies. May be left out when one account is connected.

arguments.name: recipientId
arguments.desc: participantId from list_messages.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Up to 1,000 bytes of UTF-8 as Instagram counts it (about 500 Cyrillic characters).

name: mark_post_finished
description: Marks a post the person puts up themselves — a Reddit post Hub prepared, or an Instagram post finished in the Instagram app — as posted, with the post's own address as proof: `url`, an instagram.com post or reel, or a reddit.com thread.

arguments.name: postId
arguments.desc: The post the person put up themselves.

arguments.name: channelId
arguments.desc: The Reddit or Instagram channel of the post, from get_post targets.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: The post's own address on that network.

name: read_audit_log
description: Reads the journal of this credential's own actions, newest first: what it did, on which network and post, and how each ended (no captions, no media, no secrets).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Default 50.

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: An ISO 8601 time: only actions from then on.

name: catch_up_autoreplies
description: Reads the account's recent posts and their comments from Instagram and lists the ones from the last 7 days that an auto-reply rule that is on would answer and nobody has: comments that came before the rule was made, or while it was off.

arguments.name: account
arguments.desc: Username or id from list_autoreplies.

arguments.name: ruleId
arguments.desc: Only this rule, from list_autoreplies.

arguments.name: send
arguments.desc: Answer them now.
